description: This is a PHP source file defining the UserGroup class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.User namespace. The class provides methods for managing user groups, including adding, editing, deleting, retrieving individual or multiple user groups, and managing permissions for user groups.

classes.name: UserGroup
classes.description: Represents a user group in the OpenCart admin system, providing CRUD operations and permission management functionalities.

methods.name: addUserGroup
methods.description: Adds a new user group with specified data, including name and permissions, and returns the new group's ID.

methods.name: editUserGroup
methods.description: Updates the name and permissions of an existing user group identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteUserGroup
methods.description: Deletes a user group specified by its ID.

methods.name: getUserGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details (name and permissions) of a specific user group by its ID.

methods.name: getUserGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of user groups, with optional ordering, start, and limit parameters for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUserGroups
methods.description: Returns the total number of user groups.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a permission (route) of a specific type (e.g., access, modify) to a user group identified by its ID.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission (route) of a specific type from a user group.
